summary: Telefônica Brasil S.A. filed a Form 6-K on May 11, 2026, reporting its first quarter 2026 results. The filing is a routine earnings disclosure under Rule 13a-16 or 15d-16, covering financial and operational highlights such as revenue, EBITDA, and customer base. It mentions approved shareholder remuneration including interest on equity and a new share buyback program up to R$1.0 billion, but these are ordinary capital allocation actions. No special situation—acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other event—is present. Thus, this is a routine current report not triggering any special-situations category. No deal terms apply.
